Uses inventory_has because mining fully-grown beetroot crops (age=3) drops 'beetroot' items (singular, not 'beetroots') into the player's inventory. The player starts with an empty inventory and there is no other source of beetroot in the scene, so having at least 1 beetroot confirms successful mining. This is preferred over mine_block event tracking because the item reliably ending up in inventory is the most direct signal.

Water channels at x=5 and x=11 hydrate all farmland (x=6-10, all within 4 blocks). Beetroots are set to age=3 (fully grown) so they can be harvested immediately. No tools are required — beetroot crops break instantly by hand. The spatial dependency ensures the player naturally discovers the fletching table first (visible from spawn), then navigates through the back door to find the farm.
